# balena_service_environment_variable (Resource)

Manages a service environment variable (the `service_environment_variable` resource of the `/v7` API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_service_environment_variable" "example" {
  name       = "MQTT_HOST"
  service_id = 123456
  value      = "example-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) API field `name` (short text). Name rules from the API's /config/vars: must not match `^\d|\W`; must not be `BALENA`, `RESIN`, `USER`; must not start with `BALENA_` or `RESIN_`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `service_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `service` (API field `service`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) API field `value` (text). At most 100000 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) API field `created_at` (date time).
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the service environment variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import balena_service_environment_variable.example 123456
```
